title: Add rollback consequence preview
purpose: Make rollback handles, affected resources and operator consequences visible before recovery action.
scope: Render rollback handle, target resource and base hash where available.
Render affected files, services or artifacts as redacted summaries.
Show whether rollback is automatic, requires approval or requires human review.
Add preview for failed verification and half-committed effects.
Link rollback preview to audit evidence.
acceptance_criteria: Rollback consequence preview is visible for rollback-pending state.
Preview never executes rollback by rendering.
Audit evidence remains source of rollback truth.
failure_modes: Rollback preview implies rollback already occurred.
Preview omits affected resource or audit reference.
Rendering rollback preview mutates rollback state.
